name: pincushion
description: Stakeholders pin feedback on your live app; your AI coding agent reads each pin via MCP and ships the fix.
long_description: Pincushion turns visual feedback into agent work packets. Stakeholders drop pins on your live app with the Pincushion browser extension; this MCP server exposes each pin — selector, screenshot, DOM snippet, thread, acceptance criteria — to your AI coding agent so it can read, claim, implement, and resolve feedback end to end. It reads your local project's .feedback/ directory and git; cloud sync, AI critique, and team collaboration unlock with an optional license key (free local-only mode otherwise).

project_dir.title: Project directory
project_dir.description: Your project root — the repository that contains (or will contain) a .feedback/ directory. Pincushion reads pins and git history from here.

license_key.title: License key (optional)
license_key.description: Your Pincushion Pro/Team license key — run `npx pincushion-mcp login` to get one. Enables cloud sync, AI critique, and team collaboration. Leave blank for free, local-only mode.
